title: IP-MT289-EditorSaveActions

scope.summary:
GOAL: Add VS Code 'on save' editor actions to the native code editor — format-on-save (editor.formatOnSave), trim-trailing-whitespace-on-save (files.trimTrailingWhitespace), insert-final-newline (files.insertFinalNewline), and trim-final-newlines (files.trimFinalNewlines) — as a single per-editor save-hook pipeline with per-language enable/disable settings. The MT-281 matrix marks 'format-on-save-actions' MISSING: formatting.rs is manual Format Document / Format Selection (MT-050) only; there is no save trigger and no whitespace/newline save cleanup. This MT is mostly a pure transform pipeline over the MT-001 TextBuffer plus a small settings surface; it REUSES the existing formatting.rs applier (apply_format_edits_to_string / resolve_format_outcome) and file_meta.rs (Eol / trailing-whitespace notions) — it adds NO new formatter and NO new LSP transport.

EXPECTED DIFF SHAPE: (a) NEW module src/frontend/handshake_native/src/code_editor/save_actions.rs (SaveAction enum + SaveActionConfig + the ordered save pipeline SaveActionPipeline::run(buffer, language_id) -> single WorkspaceEdit-style change set + the applied-summary); (b) `pub mod save_actions;` + re-exports in code_editor/mod.rs; (c) a save-hook call in the code editor's save path (panel.rs / the editor save site) that runs the pipeline BEFORE the bytes are written, applied as ONE undo entry combined with the save; (d) a settings section wiring in code_editor settings (the MT-072 EditorSettingsSections surface) exposing the four toggles + per-language overrides; (e) one integration test file. Pure transforms + settings; reuses formatting.rs + file_meta.rs; NO backend; NO new formatter.

DETAILED SPEC:
1. save_actions.rs: `pub enum SaveAction { FormatDocument, TrimTrailingWhitespace, InsertFinalNewline, TrimFinalNewlines }`; `pub struct SaveActionConfig { format_on_save: bool, trim_trailing_whitespace: bool, insert_final_newline: bool, trim_final_newlines: bool, per_language: HashMap<LanguageId, SaveActionOverrides> }` (MT-071 LanguageId). Defaults: all OFF (VS Code default is off; opt-in), matching VS Code's conservative default so a save never silently rewrites a file until the operator enables it.
2. Pipeline order (normative, VS Code parity): (1) FormatDocument (if enabled AND a formatter is available for the language — reuse formatting.rs formatter_available + apply_format_edits_to_string; if no formatter, skip silently, do NOT block the save), then (2) TrimTrailingWhitespace (strip trailing spaces/tabs per line, preserving the line's EOL — reuse file_meta Eol detection so CRLF vs LF is respected), then (3) InsertFinalNewline / TrimFinalNewlines (ensure exactly one trailing newline, or trim extras, using the buffer's detected EOL). The whole pipeline produces ONE combined edit applied as a single change so save = one undo entry.
3. Cursor/selection preservation (binding): running save actions must NOT jump the caret or lose the selection unexpectedly — trailing-whitespace trim on the caret's own line must keep the caret at a sensible position (VS Code keeps the caret; it does not delete whitespace the operator is actively typing before the cursor on the current line — match that 'skip the active line's trailing edit if the caret is at end of that line' nuance, or document the chosen behavior).
4. Format-on-save safety: format-on-save reuses the MT-050 formatter path; if the formatter errors or times out, the save STILL proceeds with the un-formatted (but whitespace/newline-cleaned) content and a non-blocking status note — a save must never be lost because a formatter failed (HBR-QUIET/HBR-STOP: never hang the save on the formatter). Large-file guard: format-on-save is skipped (with a note) above a configurable size threshold, matching VS Code's editor.formatOnSaveTimeout behavior.
5. Settings surface: expose the four toggles + a per-language override table in the code-editor settings section (MT-072). The settings persist through the existing settings mechanism (no new persistence system). A status-bar / save-toast note shows what actions ran on the last save ('Formatted, trimmed whitespace').
6. Scope edges: this MT owns the save-action PIPELINE + settings + the save-hook call. It REUSES formatting.rs (formatter) and file_meta.rs (EOL/whitespace); it does NOT add a formatter, does NOT modify the LSP transport, and it applies to the CODE editor (the rich editor save/draft path MT-020 has its own normalization and is out of scope here).

STEP-BY-STEP:
1. Read code_editor/formatting.rs (formatter_available, apply_format_edits_to_string, resolve_format_outcome, FormatOutcome — the reuse surface), file_meta.rs (Eol, detect_indent, RenderWhitespace — EOL + whitespace notions), panel.rs (the save site + the single-undo boundary + status note mechanism), language_mode.rs (LanguageId), the MT-072 EditorSettingsSections surface (where the toggles mount).
2. Create save_actions.rs with SaveAction/SaveActionConfig + SaveActionPipeline::run producing one combined edit + an AppliedSummary; unit-test each action in isolation and the ordered pipeline (format then trim then final-newline), EOL preservation (CRLF + LF), and all-off = no-op.
3. Wire the save-hook: run the pipeline before write, applied as one undo entry with the save; formatter failure/large-file -> skip-with-note, save proceeds.
4. Wire the settings section (four toggles + per-language overrides) into MT-072; persist via the existing settings mechanism.
5. Register `pub mod save_actions;` + re-exports in code_editor/mod.rs.
6. Integration test: enable all four; save a file with trailing whitespace, no final newline, and unformatted code -> one save produces formatted + trimmed + final-newline content in ONE undo; a formatter error still saves the whitespace-cleaned content with a note; CRLF file keeps CRLF; all-off saves byte-identical content. Capture Argus evidence of the settings section toggles + the post-save status note.
7. Update the UserManual (same change): save actions — the four toggles, per-language overrides, order of operations, format-on-save formatter/large-file behavior, and that defaults are off.
forbidden_paths: src/frontend/handshake_native/src/code_editor/formatting.rs (reuse the formatter applier; do not fork or modify it)
src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_editor/save/** (the rich-editor save path is MT-020; out of scope)
acceptance_criteria: code_editor/save_actions.rs exists with SaveAction{FormatDocument,TrimTrailingWhitespace,InsertFinalNewline,TrimFinalNewlines} + SaveActionConfig (four toggles + per-language overrides, MT-071 LanguageId) defaulting ALL OFF, and SaveActionPipeline::run producing ONE combined edit + an applied summary.

Pipeline order is Format -> TrimTrailingWhitespace -> InsertFinalNewline/TrimFinalNewlines; format-on-save reuses formatting.rs (formatter_available / apply_format_edits_to_string) and skips silently when no formatter exists (grep-provable: no new formatter).
The whole save is ONE undo entry; EOL is preserved (a CRLF file stays CRLF, an LF file stays LF) via file_meta Eol detection; all-off saves byte-identical content (no-op).

A formatter error/timeout or an over-threshold large file skips FORMAT with a non-blocking note but the save STILL proceeds with whitespace/newline-cleaned content (the save is never lost or hung on the formatter).

Trailing-whitespace trim preserves a sensible caret position and documents the active-line nuance (do not delete whitespace the operator is actively typing at the caret on the current line, or document the chosen behavior).

A settings section exposes the four toggles + per-language overrides (mounted in the MT-072 editor settings surface) and persists via the existing settings mechanism; a post-save status note reports what ran.
UserManual updated in the same change: the four toggles, per-language overrides, operation order, formatter/large-file behavior, defaults-off.
proof_targets: cargo test -p handshake-native save_actions -- --nocapture 2>&1 | grep -E 'test result: ok'
Argus evidence: argus.screenshot of the save-actions settings section (four toggles) + the post-save status note after a save that formatted + trimmed, stored under $HANDSHAKE_ARTIFACTS_ROOT
expected_tests: unit: TrimTrailingWhitespace strips per-line trailing spaces/tabs preserving EOL (CRLF + LF)
unit: InsertFinalNewline adds exactly one; TrimFinalNewlines collapses extras
unit: FormatDocument reuses formatting.rs and is skipped when no formatter is available
unit: ordered pipeline (format -> trim -> final-newline) produces one combined edit
unit: all-off config is a byte-identical no-op
integration: enable all four -> one save produces cleaned+formatted content in ONE undo
integration: formatter error still saves whitespace-cleaned content with a note (save not lost)
integration: over-threshold large file skips format with a note but still saves
implementation_notes: Verified grounding 2026-07-21: code_editor/formatting.rs (MT-050) exports formatter_available, apply_format_edits_to_string (apply_format_edits_to_string), resolve_format_outcome, FormatOutcome — the reuse surface for format-on-save; file_meta.rs exports Eol, detect_indent, RenderWhitespace — EOL + whitespace notions; language_mode.rs LanguageId (MT-071); panel.rs owns the save site + single-undo boundary + status note; settings_dialog.rs / MT-072 EditorSettingsSections is where the toggles mount. No save-action pipeline or format-on-save trigger exists today.

Design basis (cite in code docs): VS Code editor.formatOnSave, files.trimTrailingWhitespace, files.insertFinalNewline, files.trimFinalNewlines, editor.formatOnSaveTimeout, editor.codeActionsOnSave order — all default off / opt-in.

SAVE-IS-SACRED (HBR-STOP/HBR-QUIET): a save must never be lost or hung because a formatter failed or ran long. Format is best-effort; whitespace/newline cleanup is deterministic; the write always happens.
Defaults are OFF to match VS Code and to avoid silently rewriting files the operator did not opt into cleaning — a save must be predictable.

Cross-family seams (reference only): MT-050 formatting (reused formatter), MT-072 settings surface (host), MT-020 rich-editor save (distinct path, out of scope). codeActionsOnSave (organize-imports-on-save) is intentionally NOT in this MT's scope beyond the four listed actions; it can be a later addition once code_actions-on-save is prioritized.

surfaces: save-actions settings section (four toggles + per-language overrides)

target_entries: Save actions: format-on-save, trim trailing whitespace, insert/trim final newline, per-language overrides, order of operations, formatter/large-file behavior, and that defaults are off

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Save-time transforms are recorded by the existing save/undo path; this MT emits no new business events beyond the applied-summary note.
The applied-action summary and any skip reason (no formatter / formatter error / large file) are exposed as structured state so a no-context model can see exactly what a save did.
Synchronous transform pipeline; the formatter runs on the existing bounded formatter path, not a new supervised child.

risk_if_missed: Without save actions the native editor cannot keep files clean on save the way every professional IDE does: operators must manually format and hand-trim whitespace/newlines, producing noisy diffs (trailing-whitespace and missing-final-newline churn) that pollute the very worktree-merge review this WP is about.

risks: RISK-1: Lost save — a formatter error, timeout, or exception aborts the whole save, so the operator's edits are not written to disk.
RISK-2: EOL corruption — trailing-whitespace/final-newline actions rewrite CRLF as LF (or vice versa), producing a whole-file diff and breaking line endings.
RISK-3: Undo fragmentation — save actions record separate undo entries, so Ctrl+Z after save only partially reverts, leaving inconsistent content.
RISK-4: Silent default rewrite — actions default ON and silently reformat/clean a file the operator did not opt into, corrupting an unexpected diff.
RISK-5: Caret jump / active-line clobber — trailing-whitespace trim deletes whitespace the operator is typing at the caret or jumps the caret, disrupting editing.
minimum_controls: CTRL-1 (RISK-1): The write always proceeds; format is best-effort and any failure downgrades to whitespace/newline-clean-only with a note. A test injects a formatter error and asserts the file is still saved.
CTRL-2 (RISK-2): EOL is detected via file_meta Eol and preserved by every action; CRLF and LF tests assert byte-correct endings after save.
CTRL-3 (RISK-3): The pipeline emits ONE combined edit applied as a single undo entry with the save; a test asserts one Ctrl+Z reverts the whole save.
CTRL-4 (RISK-4): All four actions default OFF; a test asserts an unconfigured editor saves byte-identical content.
CTRL-5 (RISK-5): The trim action preserves caret position and skips (or documents) the active line's trailing edit at the caret; a test asserts the caret is not disrupted.

Confirmed 'format-on-save-actions' is not covered by WP-012 (MT-001..108), WP-013/014 stubs, STUDIO, or WP-011. External design basis: VS Code editor.formatOnSave + files.trim*/insertFinalNewline settings.
corrections: Format Document/Selection (MT-050) exists but is manual; there is no save hook and no whitespace/newline-on-save cleanup. This MT adds the on-save pipeline + settings, reusing the MT-050 formatter and file_meta EOL — not a new formatter. codeActionsOnSave (organize imports) is deliberately out of scope beyond the four listed actions.
